items.headline: FDA approves first treatment for young children with a rare inherited immune disorder
items.summary: U.S. regulators approved the drug leniolisib for children ages four to eleven with a rare genetic condition that weakens the immune system and raises the risk of severe infections and lymphoma. It is the first approved medicine for that age group, with doses expected to reach patients in October.
items.why_it_matters: Children with this rare disorder previously had no treatment approved specifically for their age group.
